title: UTStarcom keen to invest $20 million to start manufacturing in India

# NEWSROOM


## UTStarcom keen to invest $20 million to start manufacturing in India


The US-based company is open to creating a joint venture for this purpose, Shah said, adding that the investment is likely to be ramped up when the product lines UTStarcom is selling into expand.
